blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard $v$-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward $x$-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why $x$-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes $x$-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective $v$-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet $256\times256$, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.
blocks.zh: Latent Divusion Models在基因模型中占主导地位,但面临两阶段训练的复杂性和预先训练的自编码器固有的重建极限. 像素-空间相匹配提供了一种简化的端到端替代方案,但在使用标准的美元预测目标时却经常会遇到训练困难. 最近的研究将这一困难归因于匿名目标的非随机性质,促使人们转向美元预测。 在本文中,我们通过补丁主要组件分析(PCA)来调查这一解释,并找出带宽瓶颈. 小构件的速度主要由原始的噪音输入决定,需要深层骨干保存与主构件模型相竞争的信息. 通过有控制的实验和表示分析,我们进一步审查为什么x$预测仍然有效:其参数化提供了原始输入的绕道,而其学到的投入表示可以自发地集中于主要方向。 在低级观测中,我们对诱导流的分析将美元预测定性为一种隐含的有条件的 -- -- 平均分解器,从所保留的信息中重建被丢弃的组件。 这些观测激发了Raw-注射变形器(RiT)的动力,它结合了轻量级的原始条件解码器和输出侧快捷键,将语义模型与生态传播分离. 我们的方法恢复了有效的美元预测,并在ImageNet上实现了256\times256美元的竞争性能,为预测目标与建筑带宽之间的相互作用提供了视角.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion and Flow Matching Models [ 20 , 52 , 51 , 32 , 33 , 1 ] have emerged as a robust and powerful paradigm for visual generative modeling, demonstrating competitive generation quality and distribution coverage compared to Normalizing Flows and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) [ 48 , 17 , 2 , 26 , 11 , 45 , 43 , 3 , 63 , 19 , 44 , 16 , 35 , 15 ] . While initially applied to image synthesis, this framework has been successfully extended to diverse high-dimensional domains, including video generation [ 28 , 56 , 59 ] and audio generation [ 13 , 9 , 34 , 29 , 7 ] . Although diffusion models originally operated in raw pixel space, their performance and training efficiency often degrade as image resolution increases. These difficulties arise in part from directly learning high-frequency spatial dependencies and the quadratic complexity of dense attention mechanisms commonly used in modern diffusion backbones.
blocks.zh: 扩散与流配模型[20,52,51,32,33,1]已成为视觉基因模型的有力而有力的范例,与正常流配和流配网络(GANs)[48,17,2,26,11,45,43,3,63,19,44,16,35,15]相比,展现出具有竞争力的生成质量和分布覆盖面. 虽然这个框架最初应用于图像合成,但已经成功地扩展到了多样化的高维域,包括视频生成[28,56,59]和音频生成[13,9,34,29,7]. 虽然扩散模型最初在原始像素空间运行,但其性能和训练效率往往随着图像分辨率的提高而降低. 这些困难的部分原因是直接学习高频空间依赖性,以及现代扩散骨干中常用的密集关注机制的四重复杂性。

blocks.en: To mitigate these computational constraints, Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) [ 45 ] have become the dominant approach in recent years. By leveraging pre-trained Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) [ 27 ] to project inputs into a compressed, low-dimensional representation, LDMs effectively decouple generative modeling from high-resolution synthesis [ 42 , 36 ] . However, the reliance on complex two-stage pipelines and the reconstruction ceiling of fixed decoders have recently spurred widespread research interest in end-to-end pixel-space diffusion models [ 8 , 30 , 62 ] . To maintain computational efficiency, these models typically adopt large patch sizes (e.g., 16 × 16 16\times 16 or 32 × 32 32\times 32 ), creating high-dimensional patch representations that pose new challenges for standard diffusion objectives.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻这些计算制约因素,Latent扩散模型[45]近年来成为主导方法. 通过利用预先训练的变位自动编码器[VAEs][27]将输入投影投影为压缩低维的表示,LDMs有效地将基因模型从高分辨率合成中解析[42,36]. 然而,由于依赖复杂的两阶段管道和固定解码器的重建上限,最近引起了对端到端像素空间扩散模型的广泛研究兴趣[8、30、62]。 为了保持计算效率,这些模型一般采用大补丁尺寸(如16×16 16\times 16或32×32\times 32),形成高维补丁表示,对标准传播目标构成新的挑战.

blocks.en: Crucially, the recent JiT study [ 30 ] identifies a severe training failure in pixel space: while velocity prediction ( v v -prediction) is Flow Matching’s native regression objective, applying it directly to high-dimensional pixel patches can fail. JiT therefore adopts clean-data prediction ( x x -prediction), which substantially improves generation quality in this setting. However, the cause of this failure remains incompletely understood. This difference is often attributed to the low-dimensional manifold nature of natural images. Yet the MSE-optimal x x -predictor estimates a conditional expectation, which need not lie on the data manifold. The manifold interpretation alone therefore leaves open how prediction objectives interact with the information constraints of practical architectures.
blocks.zh: 关键是,最近的JiT研究[30]在像素空间中识别出严重的训练失败:而速度预测(v v - prepresident)是Flow Matching的本土回归目标,直接应用到高维像素补丁上可能会失败. 因此,JiT采用清洁数据预测(xx-预测),大大改善了这种环境下的生成质量。 然而,这一失败的原因仍未完全了解。 这种差异常常归因于自然图像的低维多元性. 然而,MSE-优化xx-predictor估计的是有条件的预期,这不需要存在于数据倍数上. 因此,仅从多重解释来看,预测目标如何与实际结构的信息限制相互作用,尚不明确。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of RiT and the bandwidth bottleneck. Standard v v -prediction must retain noisy input while learning semantic features, creating competing demands on backbone bandwidth. Enlarging the backbone can alleviate this conflict without extra raw injection, but incurs substantial computational overhead. RiT instead uses a lightweight raw-conditioned nonlinear decoder with sufficient post-injection capacity and an output-side shortcut. Details of the final layers are given in Section 4.5 . In contrast, x x -prediction provides an inherent raw-input bypass and can learn compact representations concentrated on principal directions. Under low-rank conditions, its induced flow reconstructs discarded components as conditional means without additional decoder layers.
blocks.zh: 图2:RiT和带宽瓶颈概览. 标准v v - 预测在学习语义特性时必须保留噪音输入,对主干带宽产生竞争需求. 扩大骨干可以减轻这种冲突,而无需额外的原始注入,但需要大量的计算费用。 RiT转而使用一个轻量级的原始条件的非线性解码器,具有足够的注入后容量和输出侧快捷键. 最后各层的详细情况见第4.5节。 相比之下,xx-预测提供了内在的原始输入绕行,可以学习集中于主要方向的紧凑的表示. 在低阶条件下,它的诱导流重建被丢弃的组件作为条件手段,而无需额外的解码层.

blocks.en: We investigate this question by analyzing image patches through Principal Component Analysis (PCA). We observe that v v -prediction converges in low-dimensional principal subspaces but deteriorates as minor components are introduced. Linear reconstruction probing reveals that v v -prediction retains substantially more raw noisy-input information through the backbone than x x -prediction. Our affine analysis links this behavior to the raw-state transport required by noise-dominated minor components, which competes with principal-component modeling. The x x -prediction parameterization provides a raw-input bypass that alleviates this demand. Under low-rank observations, its induced flow completes discarded coordinates through conditional means without propagating their noisy states through the backbone. We further observe that even without an imposed low-rank bottleneck, its input embedding can spontaneously reduce its effective rank and concentrate on principal directions.
blocks.zh: 我们通过主要组件分析分析图像补丁来调查这个问题。 我们观察到 v - 预测在低维主子空间中汇合,但随着小组件的引入而恶化. 线性重建检测显示,v-预测通过骨干保留了更多原始的噪音输入信息,而不是x-预测。 我们的亲缘分析将这种行为与噪声为主的小部件所需的原始状态运输联系起来,这些小部件与主组件模型竞争. xx - 预测参数化提供了一个原始输入绕行,可以缓解这一需求. 在低阶观测下,它的诱导流通过有条件的手段完成丢弃的坐标,而不会通过主干传播它们的吵闹状态. 我们进一步指出,即使没有强加的低级瓶颈,其投入嵌入可自动降低其有效地位,并集中于主要方向。

blocks.en: To resolve this feature bandwidth conflict, we propose the Raw-injected Transformer ( RiT ) for pixel-space Flow Matching. RiT injects the raw noisy input x t x_{t} into a lightweight subpatch decoder and combines a semantic branch with an explicit raw-input shortcut through a shared output projection. The decoder provides sufficient post-injection bandwidth to model conditional variation beyond mean reconstruction, while the shortcut supplies learnable raw-state transport. Together, these components allow content-dependent processing of the full noisy input without requiring the deep backbone to preserve every coordinate. The final architecture requires neither a precomputed PCA basis nor auxiliary perceptual, adversarial, or frequency-domain losses.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个特性带宽冲突,我们提出Raw-注射变形器(RiT)用于像素-空间流匹配. RiT通过共享输出投影向轻量级子patch解码器注入原始的噪音输入 x t x_{t},并将语义分支与明确的原始输入快捷键相结合. 解码器提供了足够的注射后带宽,可以模拟超出平均重建的有条件变化,而快捷键则提供可学习的原始状态运输. 这些组件加在一起,可以对全响的输入进行内容依赖处理,而不需要深层骨干来保存每个坐标. 最终架构既不需要预算的常设仲裁法院基础,也不需要辅助感知、对抗性或频域损失。

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments on the ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 [ 10 ] dataset at B, L, and H scales. Controlled interventions on backbone capacity, patch dimensionality, raw-input availability, and decoder bandwidth support the bandwidth interpretation. RiT restores effective v v -prediction and achieves competitive FID scores compared to x x -prediction baselines across training horizons. These results indicate that the observed failure is not an inherent limitation of velocity prediction, but depends on whether the architecture supplies the information paths required by the objective.
blocks.zh: 我们在ImageNet 256×256256\times 256[10]数据集B,L,H等尺度上进行了广泛的实验. 对骨干容量、补丁尺寸、原始投入可用性以及解码器带宽的控制干预支持带宽解释。 RiT恢复有效 v - 预测,并实现竞争性FID分数与x - 预测基线相比,跨训练视野. 这些结果表明,观察到的故障并不是速度预测的固有限制,而是取决于架构是否提供目标所要求的信息路径.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Latent diffusion has become a standard paradigm for efficient and scalable image and video generation [ 61 , 14 , 36 , 43 , 3 , 45 ] . Early systems use VAEs [ 27 ] for compact representations, while the transition from U-Net [ 46 ] to DiT [ 42 ] improves scalability and generation quality. Subsequent autoencoder designs explore higher compression ratios, channel-wise latent structures, and semantic alignment for downstream diffusion [ 4 , 5 , 60 , 56 ] . RAE [ 64 ] pairs pretrained representation encoders such as DINOv2 [ 40 ] with ViT decoders [ 12 ] , forming Transformer-based autoencoders with high-dimensional semantic latents and improving diffusion convergence and generation quality. However, autoencoder training often involves perceptual and adversarial losses, adding optimization overhead and complexity to the two-stage generation pipeline.
blocks.zh: Latent传播已成为高效和可扩展图像和视频生成的标准范式[61、14、36、43、3、45]。 早期的系统使用VAE[27]进行紧凑的表示,而从U-Net[46]到DiT[42]的过渡则提高了可伸缩性和生成质量. 之后的自动编码器设计探索了更高的压缩比,顺道潜伏结构,以及下游扩散的语义对齐[4,5,60,56]. RAE [64]对像DINOv2[40]等预训表达编码器与ViT解码器[12],以高维语义潜伏物组成变形器为基础的自动编码器,提高扩散趋同性和生成质量. 然而,自动编码器培训往往涉及感知和对抗性损失,为两阶段生成管道增加了优化的间接费用和复杂性。

blocks.en: Diffusion models were originally developed in pixel space [ 20 , 52 , 51 ] . Early high-resolution approaches include diffusion upsampling in ADM [ 11 ] and progressive super-resolution cascades in CDM [ 21 ] . SiD [ 23 ] and SiD2 [ 24 ] improve pixel-space generation through U-ViT architectures, adapted noise schedules, and loss weighting. PixelFlow [ 6 ] trains a unified DiT for multi-resolution Flow Matching, whereas RelayDiffusion [ 54 ] uses separate models for different scales. Inspired by implicit neural fields for scene reconstruction [ 39 , 50 ] , PixNerd [ 57 ] introduces neural-field decoding after the DiT backbone, achieving competitive results at patch size 16.
blocks.zh: 扩散模型最初是在像素空间[20,52,51]中开发的. 早期的高分辨率方法包括在ADM[11]中进行扩散提升采样,在CDM[21]中进行进步的超分辨率级联. SiD[23]和SiD2[24]通过U-ViT架构改进像素-空间生成,调整噪声表,以及减重. PixelFlow [6] trains a united DiT 用于多分辨率流匹配,而RelayDiffusion [54] 对不同的尺度使用单独的模型. 受场景重建隐含神经场[39,50]的启发,PixNerd[57]在DiT主干线后引入神经场解码,在补丁尺寸16实现竞争结果.

blocks.en: More recently, JiT [ 30 ] finds clean-image prediction more effective than direct velocity prediction for large-patch pixel-space Transformers and attributes this advantage to the low-dimensional data manifold. Other methods augment DiT for high-frequency detail modeling: PixelDiT [ 62 ] adds pixel-level Transformer blocks with linear token compression and expansion; DeCo [ 37 ] couples a lightweight pixel decoder with a frequency-aware Flow Matching loss; and DiP [ 8 ] introduces a lightweight convolutional U-Net Patch Detailer Head. DDT [ 58 ] also separates semantic encoding from velocity decoding by supplying the noisy input directly to a dedicated decoder, but operates in compressed VAE latent space rather than on high-dimensional pixel patches.
blocks.zh: 最近,JiT [30] 发现对大patch像素-空间变换器的清洁图像预测比直接速度预测更有效,并将这一优势归属于低维数据多维. 其他方法为高频细节建模增加了DiT: PixelDiT [62] 增加了像素级变压器块,具有线性符号压缩和扩展功能; DeCo [37] 夫妇一个轻量级的像素解码器,具有频率感知的流量匹配损失;以及 DiP [8] 引入了轻量级折叠的 U-Net 补丁级变压器头. DDT [58] 还将语义编码与速度解码区分开来,直接向专用解码器提供噪音输入,但在压缩的VAE潜伏空间中运行,而不是在高维像素补丁上运行.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: We present our methodology for reviving v v -prediction in pixel-space Flow Matching. Despite its simple, time-independent regression target x 1 − x 0 x_{1}-x_{0} , direct v v -prediction can fail when high-dimensional pixel patches must be processed within a limited hidden representation. We investigate this difficulty through patch-wise PCA, which shows that v v -prediction trains successfully in lower-dimensional principal subspaces but deteriorates as minor components are introduced. Linear reconstruction probing then reveals a stronger tendency to retain noisy-input information throughout the backbone.

We explain this behavior through an affine analysis of component-wise velocity transport and examine two complementary advantages of x x -prediction: its raw-input bypass and its tendency to learn representations concentrated on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, we characterize how the induced flow reconstructs discarded components as conditional means. Building on these insights, RiT combines a lightweight raw-conditioned nonlinear decoder with an output-side shortcut. Controlled experiments on backbone width, patch dimensionality, decoder capacity, and raw-input availability test the bandwidth interpretation and clarify the roles of these components.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对元件智能速度迁移的亲和分析来解释这一行为,并研究xx预测的两个互补优势:其原始输入绕行和学习主要方向的表示的倾向. 在低级观测下,我们描述引流如何重建被丢弃的组件作为条件手段. 基于这些见解,RiT结合了轻量级的原始条件非线性解码器和输出侧快捷键. 对骨干宽度,补丁维度,解码能力,以及原始投入可用性进行控制实验,测试带宽解释,澄清这些组件的作用.

In the 128-dimensional principal subspace, v v -prediction converges successfully and achieves lower FID than x x -prediction. At k = 128,192,256 k=128,192,256 , training in the principal subspace also improves FID relative to full-space training for both objectives at this training budget. However, v v -prediction is more sensitive to minor components: as the dimension expands from 128 to 384, its FID rises from 33.99 to 47.41, and full-space training deteriorates to 149.07. In contrast, x x -prediction remains effective across all tested dimensions, reaching an FID of 40.39 at full rank. These observations suggest that x x -prediction has an advantage in handling noise-dominated minor directions, and that the failure of direct v v -prediction depends on the information demands placed on the architecture rather than solely on the velocity target itself.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , increasing backbone capacity or reducing patch size can restore vanilla v v -prediction, but both interventions introduce additional computational costs. In particular, a patch-8 backbone increases the sequence length throughout the network, whereas RiT processes finer-resolution tokens using only two lightweight decoder blocks. Within the decoder family, two width-384 blocks fail without direct raw-input access but converge when it is provided. Conversely, a width-128 decoder fails despite receiving the 192-dimensional raw subpatches, while widths 256 and 384 train effectively. These controlled interventions suggest that both raw-input availability and sufficient post-injection bandwidth are important for restoring v v -prediction.

blocks.en: Our contribution is primarily explanatory and methodological. We focus on understanding the information requirements of pixel-space prediction objectives and providing an architectural intervention that alleviates the resulting bandwidth bottleneck. This perspective complements other advances in generative modeling, including representation alignment (REPA [ 61 ] ), in-patch convolutional decoders (DiP [ 8 ] ), and frequency-aware training losses (DeCo [ 37 ] ). RiT provides a lightweight realization of the design principles identified by our analysis, rather than prescribing a single architecture for pixel-space generation. These results suggest ways to build on these principles through more expressive raw-conditioned decoders and complementary training techniques.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We investigate the failure of direct v v -prediction in pixel-space Flow Matching through patch-wise PCA, affine analysis, linear reconstruction probes, and controlled architectural experiments. Our results identify a bandwidth bottleneck in which preserving raw noisy state for minor-component velocity estimation competes with principal-component modeling. We further examine two complementary aspects of x x -prediction: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input embedding can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our flow analysis characterizes x x -prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, completing discarded components without propagating their noisy states through the backbone. This completion can capture nonlinear dependence on retained information but does not generally recover the full conditional distribution. RiT combines a lightweight raw-conditioned nonlinear decoder for modeling conditional variation with a learnable output shortcut for raw-state transport, achieving competitive performance on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 . These findings show that v v -prediction can be effective when architectural bandwidth and information paths accommodate the demands of the prediction objective.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了直接vv的失败, 预测在像素-空间流匹配 通过补丁-wise-wise PCA,affine 分析,线性重建探测器, 和控制的建筑实验。 我们的结果显示带宽瓶颈,在这种瓶颈中,为小组件速度估计保留原始噪音状态与主组件模型竞争。 我们进一步审查xx预测的两个互补方面:其参数化提供了原始输入绕行,而其所学输入嵌入可以自发集中于主要方向. 在低排名观测下,我们的流量分析将xx预测定性为隐含的有条件-平均编码器,完成丢弃的组件而不通过骨干传播其噪音状态. 这种完成可以捕捉对保留信息的非线性依赖,但一般不会完全恢复有条件的分布. RiT将用于模拟条件变异的轻量级原始条件非线性解码器与用于原始状态运输的可学习输出快捷键相结合,在ImageNet上实现竞争性能256×256256\times 256. 这些调查结果表明,如果建筑带宽和信息路径能满足预测目标的要求,v-预测可以有效.

blocks.en: The two prediction objectives therefore produce different results under the same low-rank observation. As proved above, x x -prediction removes the initial minor noise and reconstructs the centered discarded coordinates as m 0 ​ ( y ​ ( 0 ) , ℓ ) m_{0}(y(0),\ell) . This allows the backbone to focus on retained information while completing the missing components through their conditional means. However, the reconstructed minor components are deterministic given the retained endpoint and class, whereas the original data may contain additional conditional variation. Direct v v -prediction instead preserves the discarded Gaussian noise with unit variance and cannot adapt its distribution without observing that noise.

blocks.en: These results motivate the two components of RiT. By directly receiving the full noisy state, the raw-conditioned nonlinear decoder can process information discarded by the backbone bottleneck, allowing the backbone to focus on retained information while the decoder models nonlinear dependencies and conditional variation in minor components. This provides greater expressive capacity than the conditional-mean completion of the restricted x x -predictor. The output-side shortcut further provides a learnable approximation to the affine transport analyzed in Appendix A , reducing the need for the decoder to learn this simpler contribution through its nonlinear layers. Together, these components allow RiT to retain a compact backbone representation while modeling richer joint conditional distributions in pixel space.
blocks.zh: 这些成果激励了RiT的两个组成部分. 通过直接接收全响状态,原始条件的非线性解码器可以处理被骨干瓶颈丢弃的信息,使得骨干在解码器模型非线性依赖性和小组件有条件的变异时可以专注于保留的信息. 这提供的表达能力比限制的x-predictor有条件的完成更大. 输出侧快捷键进一步提供了附录A所分析的对芬运输的可学习近似值,减少了解码器通过非线性层来学习这一更简单贡献的需要. 这些组件一起使RIT能够保留紧凑的骨干代表,同时在像素空间中模拟更丰富的联合有条件分布.

blocks.en: We compare an image with its affine reconstruction using the leading 128 of 768 patch components in Figure 6 . Although many coordinates are discarded, much of the visible structure remains. This illustrates how the retained components can provide context for completing missing details, making conditional-mean reconstruction a plausible use of a compact representation. The displayed reconstruction is a linear PCA projection rather than the conditional-mean decoder analyzed above; it does not establish that discarded details are uniquely determined by the retained components.

blocks.en: The backbones follow the B, L, and H configurations of JiT [ 30 ] . The principal architectural settings are listed in Table 6 . The input embedding consists of two linear maps with the indicated intermediate width, which constrains the learned backbone input map without changing the pixel-space data or noise. We use fixed two-dimensional sinusoidal input position embeddings, two-dimensional rotary position embeddings in attention, RMS normalization, and SwiGLU feed-forward layers, with the same block type in the lightweight decoder. Thirty-two class tokens are inserted after 4, 8, and 10 backbone blocks for B, L, and H, respectively. These tokens participate in the remaining backbone blocks and are removed before the image features enter the decoder.

blocks.en: The backbone and decoder residual modulation layers are zero-initialized following the baseline convention. blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Our experiments focus on class-conditional ImageNet generation at 256 × 256 256\times 256 and B, L, and H model scales. Generalization to higher resolutions, text-conditioned generation, other data distributions, and larger models remains to be studied. RiT provides a simple and effective realization of the identified bandwidth principle, while more expressive and efficient raw-conditioned decoder designs may offer further improvements in future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验重点是以256×256 256\times 256和B,L,和H模型尺度的类条件图像网生成. 通向更高分辨率,文本条件生成,其他数据分布,以及更大的模型仍有待研究. RiT为识别的带宽原则提供了简单有效的实现,而更清晰高效的原始条件解码器设计可以为今后的工作带来进一步的改进.

blocks.en: Our work provides insights into the relationship between prediction objectives and architectural information flow, which may facilitate the development of more effective end-to-end pixel-space generative models. As with other image generation methods, improved synthesis capabilities may also be misused to produce misleading content or deepfakes. Since this work focuses on fundamental modeling principles, we do not introduce additional deployment-specific safeguards, which remain important considerations for practical applications.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作为预测目标与建筑信息流动之间的关系提供了深刻的见解,这可能有助于开发更有效的端到端像素空间基因模型. 与其他图像生成方法一样,改进后的合成能力也可能被滥用于产生误导内容或深层假象. 由于这项工作侧重于基本的建模原则,我们没有引入额外的针对部署的保障措施,这仍然是实际应用的重要考虑。
